Cytokine release syndrome risk often falls as step-up doses rise, so prior
exposure is doing something that the current dose cannot explain. This project
models that something by reusing the published epcoritamab repeated
time-to-event model, and asks how far publicly available data can carry it.
Nothing has been read or fit yet.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The objective, the hypothesis,
  the model hierarchy, the data inventory, and the order of work. Its **In
  brief** section is one screen and says what the rest argues. Section 3, the
  dissection of the published epcoritamab model, is the first work and
  everything after it is written to be revised by what it finds.
- [References](references.qmd). What to read and in what order, and a marker
  on every source recording whether the specification's use of it has been
  checked. Every marker is currently ❌.
